sentences.text:
Honourable Sri Justice D.V.S.S. Somayajulu
 Criminal Petition No.4057 of 2019
Order:

This Criminal Petition is filed, under Section 482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973, to quash the proceedings against the petitioners-A.1 and A.2 in C.C. No.203 of 2019 on the file of the Court of Additional Judicial First Class Magistrate, Nandigama, for the offences under Sections 269, 270,
271, 273, 420, 418 read with 34 IPC, Sections 5 and 22 of Cigarettes and Other Tobacco Products Prohibition, Advertisement and Regulation, Trade, Production Supply and Distribution Act, 2003 and Sections 58, 59 and 63 of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006.

entities.text: Additional Judicial First Class Magistrate, Nandigama
entities.label: COURT

entities.text: Cigarettes and Other Tobacco Products Prohibition, Advertisement and Regulation, Trade, Production Supply and Distribution Act, 2003
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text:
2. Heard the learned counsel for the petitioners and learned Public Prosecutor for the respondent-State.
3.
Both the counsels agree that this matter is squarely covered by the judgment of the single Judge in the batch petitions bearing Criminal Petition Nos.3731 of 2018 and others.
The same was also followed in Criminal Petition No.1697 of 2019 and others by the learned single Judges of this Court.

entities.text: Criminal Petition No.1697 of 2019 and others
entities.label: CASE_NUMBER

sentences.text:
4. In view of the fact that this matter is squarely covered by the earlier orders, the Criminal Petition is allowed and the proceedings against the petitioners in C.C. No.203 of 2019 on the file of the Court of Additional Judicial First Class Magistrate, Nandigama, for the offences under Sections 269, 270,
271, 273, 420, 418 read with 34 IPC, Sections 5 and 22 of Cigarettes and Other Tobacco Products Prohibition, Advertisement and Regulation, Trade, Production Supply and Distribution Act, 2003 and Sections 58, 59 and 63 of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006, are hereby quashed.
